fields.description:
Objective

Create the Player and Referrer Person Account record types with separate layouts and field sets. The same person may exist once as a Player and once as a Referrer sharing an email.

Fields

  • — PLAYER record type —

  • Player ID — Player_ID__c — Auto Number

  • Player External ID — Player_External_Id__c — Text(80), External ID, Unique — primary API upsert key

  • Primary Email — PersonEmail — Email (standard)

  • E-Transfer Email — E_Transfer_Email__c — Email

  • Secondary Email — Secondary_Email__c — Email

  • Phone — PersonMobilePhone — Phone (standard)

  • Country — Country__c — Text(80)

  • State/Province — State_Province__c — Text(80)

  • Signup Currency — Signup_Currency__c — Picklist — CAD; USD used the OOTB Currency

  • Rep (BA) — Rep__c — Lookup(User)

  • Player Status — Player_Status__c — Picklist, Required — Pending; Active; Inactive; Deactivated; Banned; Flagged for Fraud

  • Player Status Reason — Player_Status_Reason__c — Picklist — Player Request; Inactivity; Compliance Hold; Duplicate Account; Edited or Suspicious Screenshots; Hedging or Low-Value Betting Pattern; Suspicious Identity; Other

  • Status Set Date — Player_Status_Set_Date__c — Date/Time

  • Status Last Updated By — Player_Status_Last_Updated_By__c — Lookup(User)

  • Survey Completed — Survey_Completed__c — Checkbox

  • Date Survey Completed — Date_Survey_Completed__c — Date

  • Last Sign-Up Date — Last_Sign_Up_Datec — deferred to post-POC (depends on Sign-Up relationship)

  • Profile Complete % — Profile_Complete_Percentc — Formula(Percent)

  • Related Referrer Profile — Related_Referrer_Profile__c — Lookup(Account) — filtered to Referrer record type

  • Date of Birth — Date_of_Birth__c — Date

  • Review Required — Review_Required__c — Checkbox

  • Review Reason — Review_Reason__c — Long Text Area(4000)

  • Email Record Type Unique — Email_Record_Type_Unique__c — Text(255), Unique, case-insensitive — omit from layouts; populated by flow in BUILD-03

  • — REFERRER record type —

  • Referrer ID — Referrer_ID__c — Auto Number

  • Email — PersonEmail — Email (standard)

  • Phone — PersonMobilePhone — Phone (standard)

  • Default Referral Type — Default_Referral_Type__c — Picklist — Cash; Bet Credit

  • Default Referrer Currency — Default_Referrer_Currency__c — Picklist — CAD; USD

  • Default Referrer Country — Default_Referrer_Country__c — Text(80)

  • Default Referrer State/Province — Default_Referrer_State_Province__c — Text(80)

  • Assigned Rep (BA) — Assigned_Rep__c — Lookup(User)

  • Primary/Secondary Indicator — Primary_Secondary_Indicator__c — Picklist — Primary; Secondary

  • Active Status — Active_Status__c — Picklist — Active; Inactive; Review Required

  • Related Player Profile — Related_Player_Profile__c — Lookup(Account) — filtered to Player record type

Implementation Requirements

  • Create Player and Referrer Person Account record types, each with its own page layout

  • Create the fields listed above; help text per design doc stories D-01 and D-02

  • Inactive status is system-set only; Deactivated/Banned require a status reason, but that requirement must not block API or automation updates

Acceptance Criteria

  • Both record types exist with distinct layouts

  • A Player and a Referrer can share the same email as two separate records

  • Deactivated without a reason warns a user but does not block an automation write

Testing Notes

Create one Player and one Referrer with the same email.

Out of Scope

Matching rules, duplicate rules, and cross-link automation (BUILD-03). Uniqueness-key population flow (BUILD-03).

Open Questions

  • Are Country and State/Province values finite? If yes, convert to picklists (client to confirm).

Additional Notes

  • Create Email_Record_Type_Unique__c now (schema only) so BUILD-03 does not need a schema change later; the populating flow comes with BUILD-03.

Estimate: L · ~12h · Dependencies: POC-01 · Ticket POC-08 (approved 2026-07-04)
